channel.title: Hadi Mobarra — Blog
channel.description: Articles on advanced JavaScript, React, TypeScript and front-end engineering.

item.title: Inside the JavaScript Event Loop: Tasks, Microtasks and the Rendering Steps
item.description: A precise mental model of how the browser schedules your code — tasks, microtasks, requestAnimationFrame and rendering — and how to use it to write UIs that never freeze.

item.title: Building a Fine-Grained Reactivity System (Signals) From Scratch
item.description: Signals power Solid, Preact, Angular and Vue's reactivity. Build one in under 100 lines to understand dependency tracking, computed values, effects and glitch-free updates.

item.title: Metaprogramming in JavaScript with Proxy and Reflect
item.description: Intercept property access, validation, and function calls with Proxy traps. Learn the invariants, the role of Reflect and receivers, and build a tiny reactive store, a validation layer and a negative-index array.

item.title: Taming INP: A Practical Guide to Interaction to Next Paint
item.description: INP replaced FID as a Core Web Vital. Learn how it's measured, how to find the slow interactions in your app, and the concrete techniques that cut it: yielding, deferring non-urgent work, React transitions and smaller DOMs.

item.title: Type-Level Programming in TypeScript: Conditional, Mapped and Template Literal Types
item.description: Treat TypeScript's type system as a small functional language. Learn conditional types and infer, distributive behaviour, key remapping, recursive types and template literals, then build a type-safe router and a deep-path getter.

item.title: Off the Main Thread: Web Workers, Transferables and RPC in Practice
item.description: Move expensive work off the UI thread. Covers dedicated workers in modern bundlers, structured clone costs, zero-copy transferables, a promise-based RPC layer, SharedArrayBuffer with Atomics, and OffscreenCanvas.

item.title: A Mental Model for React Server Components and Streaming
item.description: Server Components, Client Components, the RSC payload, Suspense streaming and Server Actions — explained as one coherent model, with the composition patterns and pitfalls that matter in a real Next.js codebase.

item.title: Async Iterators, Generators and Web Streams in Practice
item.description: Process data incrementally instead of all at once. A practical tour of generators, async iteration, backpressure, and the Web Streams API — with examples for paginated APIs, streaming fetch responses and LLM-style token streams.

item.title: The Browser Rendering Pipeline: Writing 60fps Animations
item.description: Style, layout, paint and composite — what each stage costs, which CSS properties trigger which stages, and how to build animations that stay smooth with transforms, will-change, FLIP and the View Transitions API.

item.title: Hunting Memory Leaks in JavaScript Applications
item.description: How garbage collection really decides what to keep, the five leak patterns behind most SPA memory issues, and a repeatable DevTools workflow using heap snapshots, allocation timelines and WeakRef-aware design.

item.title: Next.js Best Practices for Building Scalable Applications
item.description: Learn the essential best practices for building production-ready Next.js applications that scale well and remain maintainable.

item.title: Front-End Performance Optimization Guide
item.description: A comprehensive guide to optimizing front-end performance, covering Core Web Vitals, lazy loading, code splitting, and more.

item.title: React Architecture: Building Maintainable Applications
item.description: Explore proven architectural patterns for building large-scale React applications that are easy to maintain and extend.
